The '''angler''', also known as '''spider-angler''', was a bloblike, multi-ocular crustaceal mollusk that was native to [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]].

==Biology and appearance==
The angler "fishes" for underwater prey by dangling rootlike tentacles/claws below the water's surface. Some prey, like the [[Mucous salamander/Legends|mucous salamander]], could easily avoid an angler's clutches when underwater.

Following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the collector [[Breac Slaus]] tasked a group of spacers to hunt and kill an unreasonable number of anglers.<ref name="SWG:AA">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=collection|Angler Exterminator}}</ref>
